record.paper_title: Some open problems in the context of skew PBW extensions and semi-graded rings
record.original_question: Let B be a semi-graded Artin-Schelter regular algebra over a field K of characteristic 0, and assume that B is left and right noetherian, generated in degree 1, and has global dimension 3. Must B be cancellative; that is, whenever B[t] is isomorphic to C[t] as K-algebras for some K-algebra C, does it follow that B is isomorphic to C?

evidence.quote: • Let B be a SAS algebra over a field K with char(K) = 0. Assume that B is noetherian (left and right), generated in degree 1 and gld(B) = 3. Is B cancellative?

Observe that if in the previous theorem we could remove the condition not P I, then the classical commutative ZCP problem would be solved for n = 3. With this, we can formulate our last problem in the next subsection.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Work over a field $K$ of characteristic $0$. A $K$-algebra $B$ is called semi-graded if $B = \bigoplus_{n\geq 0} B_n$ as a $K$-vector space with $1 \in B_0$, $B_n B_m \subseteq \bigoplus_{k\leq n+m} B_k$, and each $B_n$ finite-dimensional over $K$. Such $B$ is said to be semi-graded Artin–Schelter (SAS) regular if it has finite global dimension $d$, finite Gelfand–Kirillov dimension, and satisfies the Gorenstein-type condition $\mathrm{Ext}^i_B(K,B) = 0$ for $i \neq d$ and $\mathrm{Ext}^d_B(K,B) \cong K$ (with analogous condition on the right). Say $B$ is cancellative if, for every $K$-algebra $C$, an isomorphism of $K$-algebras $B[t] \cong C[t]$ (polynomial rings in one central indeterminate) implies $B \cong C$ as $K$-algebras.

Question: Let $B$ be a SAS regular $K$-algebra that is left and right noetherian, generated as a $K$-algebra in degree $1$, and has global dimension $3$. Must $B$ be cancellative?
artifact.status_search_result: The cancellation question for connected graded AS-regular algebras of global dimension 3 has been studied (e.g., results establishing cancellation in the non-PI case), but the broader question for semi-graded AS-regular algebras of global dimension 3 (allowing non-connected grading) is posed as an open problem in the noncommutative cancellation literature, with no resolution found in recent searches.

status_evidence.snippet: Cancellation problem for AS-Regular algebras of dimension three (connected graded case).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist for connected graded AS-regular algebras of dimension 3, but the semi-graded version remains posed as a separate open problem.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems in the Context of Skew PBW Extensions and Semi-graded Rings
status_evidence.snippet: Open problems including Zariski cancellation property reformulated for semi-graded rings.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed among open problems for semi-graded AS-regular algebras.

status_evidence.title: Zariski cancellation problem for noncommutative algebras
status_evidence.claim: General framework; cancellation in the SAS gldim 3 case is not asserted.
